payload.question: Which asset type has the most alarmed sensor readings?

candidates.sql: SELECT T1.type_name FROM asset_types AS T1 JOIN assets AS T2 ON T1.asset_type_id = T2.asset_type_id JOIN sensor_readings AS T3 ON T2.asset_id = T3.asset_id WHERE T3.alarm_flag = 1 GROUP BY T1.type_name ORDER BY COUNT(T3.alarm_flag) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.type_name, COUNT(T2.alarm_flag) AS alarm_count FROM asset_types AS T1 INNER JOIN sensor_readings AS T2 ON T1.asset_type_id = T2.asset_type_id WHERE T2.alarm_flag = 1 GROUP BY T1.type_name ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 1;
